adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (per-user facts) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, LLM-based resolution of conflicting records; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
